title: Add an AT skew ring to the human mitochondrial genome map
summary: Start from the Web defaults for the human mitochondrial genome, then name the genes, restyle the figure, tidy the layout, and build a custom track stack with an added AT skew ring, generating after each change.
primaryWorkflow: Circular custom track slots with AT skew

downloads.label: NC_012920
downloads.note: Download the complete human mitochondrial genome as a GenBank flat file and save it as HmmtDNA.gbk, the filename stored in the Gallery session.

downloads.label: Qualifier priority table
downloads.note: Download this repository-managed TSV beside HmmtDNA.gbk for the runnable CLI command.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Circular mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and check that the Circular drawing is shown before adding the mitochondrial GenBank input.

media.caption: The Circular drawing is shown when the app opens.

actions.script: () => window.__GBDRAW_APP__?.mode === 'circular'

manualSteps.title: Upload the GenBank file
manualSteps.body: Upload HmmtDNA.gbk, the human mitochondrial reference record NC_012920.1. Set Output Prefix and Species; type the <i> tags in Species literally to italicize the center label.

media.alt: Circular GenBank uploader with the HmmtDNA.gbk file chip.
media.caption: Upload HmmtDNA.gbk in the Circular GenBank uploader.

manualSteps.title: Generate with the defaults
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The defaults draw the features on two strands in the stock colors, a GC content ring, and a GC skew ring, with the legend at the left. No gene is named yet.

media.caption: Web defaults: no gene names and the stock colors.

manualSteps.title: Name the genes
manualSteps.body: Open Labels and set Label Mode to Out. Under Qualifier Priority, choose the feature type CDS, enter gene as the qualifier order, and click Add priority rule, so CDS labels show compact gene names such as ND1, COX1, ATP6, and CYTB instead of long product names. Set Label Font Size to 20 and click Generate Diagram.

manualSteps.title: Tidy the layout
manualSteps.body: The Gallery figure draws this one-record genome without the Multi-Record Canvas and with all features in one lane. Open Layout and clear Multi-Record Canvas and Separate Strands. Under Dinucleotide content/skew, set Window to 500 and Step to 50 (the default for a genome under 1 Mb is 1000 and 100), so the GC rings show finer local changes along the genome. Click Generate Diagram.

manualSteps.title: Build a custom track stack
manualSteps.body: Only GC is shown so far, and the default rings leave no room for another one. Open Layout, open Custom Track Slots, and check Use custom stack. Click Replace the current custom stack with the Middle template (the button Middle under Reset to preset): the stack becomes features, ticks, gc_content, and gc_skew. Set the Width of gc_content and gc_skew to 0.1, then click Generate Diagram.

replay.script: const labels = ["Layout"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

manualSteps.title: Add the AT skew track
manualSteps.body: Under the stack, choose Dinucleotide skew as the New circular track renderer and click Add track. Rename the new row to a_skew_2, then open its disclosure (the line below Width and Radius) and set it to AT skew with its own colors.

manualSteps.title: Move the ticks inside and generate
manualSteps.body: On the ticks row, click Move inward three times so ticks is last in the stack, after a_skew_2, and set its tick label layout to Labels inside / ticks outside. Click Generate Diagram: the figure now has GC content, GC skew, and AT skew rings, and the left legend lists AT skew (+) and AT skew (-).

media.caption: Place ticks after the AT skew slot and keep Labels inside / ticks outside.

manualSteps.title: Inspect a feature
manualSteps.body: Click the RNR2 l-rRNA feature in the interactive SVG and open Details to inspect its feature type and length. The popup header gives the label, record, and location.

media.alt: RNR2 Details popup beside the highlighted l-rRNA feature in the human mitochondrial AT skew diagram.
media.caption: The Details popup identifies the highlighted RNR2 l-rRNA feature and its location.

actions.script: async () => { document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1.35; const frame = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve), 300)); await frame(); for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) { const rect = document.querySelector("[data-gbdraw-feature-id='fbdb78069']")?.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!rect) throw new Error("Pan target [data-gbdraw-feature-id='fbdb78069'] was not found."); const dx = 820 - rect.left; const dy = 300 - rect.top; if (Math.abs(dx) < 1 && Math.abs(dy) < 1) break; app.canvasPan.x += dx; app.canvasPan.y += dy; await frame(); } }

() => { const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const feature = app?.extractedFeatures?.find((entry) => entry.svg_id === 'fbdb78069'); return Boolean(app?.results?.[0]?.content?.includes("data-gbdraw-feature-id=\"fbdb78069\"") && feature?.gene === 'RNR2' && feature?.product === 'l-rRNA' && feature?.qualifiers?.db_xref?.includes('GeneID:4550')); }

const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const popup = document.querySelector('.feature-popup'); if (!app || !popup) throw new Error('RNR2 feature popup is unavailable.'); if (app.clickedFeature) app.clickedFeature.activeTab = 'details'; popup.style.width = '440px'; if (app.clickedFeaturePos) { app.clickedFeaturePos.x = 12; app.clickedFeaturePos.y = 300; }

() => { const popup = document.querySelector('.feature-popup'); const target = document.querySelector("[data-gbdraw-feature-id='fbdb78069']"); const text = popup?.textContent || ''; if (!popup || !target || !text.includes('RNR2') || !text.includes('l-rRNA')) return false; const popupRect = popup.getBoundingClientRect(); const targetRect = target.getBoundingClientRect(); return popupRect.left >= 0 && popupRect.bottom <= window.innerHeight && targetRect.left >= 0 && targetRect.right <= window.innerWidth && popupRect.right <= targetRect.left; }

postGenerationEdits.title: Review the generated legend
postGenerationEdits.body: Generate Diagram adds AT skew (+) and AT skew (-) to the legend. To change them, click the Editor button on the right edge of the preview and open the Legend tab. Rename an entry in its text field, drag a row by its grip to reorder, or use the Sort buttons; Reset position and Reset strokes undo layout and stroke changes. The two entries represent positive and negative skew.

media.alt: Editor drawer on the Legend tab, scrolled to the AT skew (+) and AT skew (-) entries, each with a color swatch, a name field, and Stroke options and Remove buttons; Sort and Reset position and Reset strokes buttons sit above the list.
media.caption: The Legend tab of the Editor drawer lists the generated entries, including AT skew (+) and AT skew (-).

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.resultPanelTab = 'preview';

() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-legend-drawer-row] input')).find((input) => input.value === 'AT skew (-)'); return Boolean(row) && document.querySelector('#right-drawer-panel-legend')?.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0; }

const list = document.querySelector('#right-drawer-panel-legend .custom-scrollbar'); if (!list) throw new Error('Legend list not found.'); list.scrollTop = list.scrollHeight; document.querySelector('.right-drawer')?.setAttribute('data-capture', 'legend-drawer'); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[data-legend-drawer-row]'); rows[rows.length - 1]?.setAttribute('data-capture', 'legend-last-row'); document.querySelector('.drawer-toggle')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.activeElement?.blur();

troubleshooting.title: AT skew is missing from the legend
troubleshooting.body: Check that the added slot uses renderer Dinucleotide skew, dinucleotide AT, and legend label AT skew.

troubleshooting.title: The features sit on two strands or the center text lacks the species
troubleshooting.body: Clear Separate Strands and Multi-Record Canvas in Layout, then click Generate Diagram again.

troubleshooting.title: The skew rings overlap labels or ticks
troubleshooting.body: Check that Use custom stack is on with the Middle template, and that ticks is the last row, after a_skew_2.

troubleshooting.title: Labels show long product names
troubleshooting.body: Check that the CDS qualifier priority rule uses gene before regenerating the diagram.

troubleshooting.title: The generated diagram differs from the Gallery image
troubleshooting.body: Check input record NC_012920.1, Label Mode Out, Label Font Size 20, the ajisai palette, Default font size 28, Multi-Record Canvas and Separate Strands off, Window 500, Step 50, the AT skew colors, and the tick label layout.
